summary:
plan.md is written (no build or render yet). The obelisk stands 7x7 at x47..53, z47..53 on the y5 summit, steps in to 5x5 at y38 and ends in a pyramid of stairs with a dark tip at y76. Lower 19 courses smooth_quartz, the rest calcite/smooth_sandstone courses: a sharp colour line at y25.
It reads as the Washington Monument by silhouette: a plain white needle on a round granite plaza, ringed by 50 end-rod flagpoles at r16 with stars-and-stripes banners, a great ring walk around the knoll and Mall walks running east-west. Warm froglights sit at its base for dusk. Smooth 7→5 wide marble obelisk (pale quartz to y24, cream calcite/sandstone above, stair pyramidion to y76) on a mapped grassy knoll. Round granite plaza with seating arcs and a pavilion, 50-pole flag ring, radiating walks, lamps, froglight floodlights, edge trees and a corner lodge.
Six parts: ground, obelisk, plaza, flags, walks and trees, lodge. No interior rooms.

parts.name: ground and knoll
parts.scope: Every column x0..99 z0..99 from the height map: stone y1..h-4, dirt h-3..h-1, grass_block at h; outer 2 rings exact. Uses groundColumn.

parts.name: obelisk
parts.scope: x47..53 z47..53 y6..24 smooth_quartz; y25..37 calcite/sandstone courses; taperRing y38; 5x5 shaft to y68; windows y66, red lights y67; pyramidion y69..76. Uses shaftCourse, taperRing, obsWindows, pyramidCourse.

parts.name: plaza and pavilion
parts.scope: Round plaza r<10.5 at y5 with andesite bands, 8 seating-wall arcs at y6 with lanterns, screening pavilion x54..58 z49..52. Uses plazaDisc, seatingArc, pavilionBox.

parts.name: flag ring and floodlights
parts.scope: Ring walk r15.5..17.5, 50 flagpoles r=16 y6..11 with banners, ochre_froglight floodlights at the base and the pole feet. Uses flagPole, floodlight.

parts.name: walks, lamps, lawn lights and trees
parts.scope: Mall E/W, N/S, diagonal and great-ring walks in white_concrete_powder with slab half steps, lamp posts every 9 cells, lawn froglights every 12, 12 edge oak trees. Uses walkCell, lampPost, floodlight, oakTree.

parts.name: survey lodge
parts.scope: x83..85 z98..99 y3..5 stone_bricks walls, stair hip, ridge slab, glass slit at (83,4,99); final light check. Uses lodgeHip.

parts: walks, lamps, lawn lights and trees

Floodlights, flag lighting, lamps, no-spawn coverage
